page_title: LYO 2-0 ANG | Lyon v Angers 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+1' This is a yellow card! Enzo Caumont (Angers) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+1' A lofted cross from Lanroy Machine (Angers) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here comes a substitution. Abner Vinicius (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Rayan Cherki.
89' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Teo Barisic (Lyon) replaces Duje Caleta-Car.
89' A goal, which was scored by Rayan Cherki (Lyon), was disallowed due to offside.
88' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Lanroy Machine (Angers) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Angers manage to earn a corner.
84' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lanroy Machine (Angers) replacing Lilian Raolisoa.
84' A substitution has been made. Esteban Lepaul goes off and Prosper Peter (Angers) comes on.
84' Referee Stephanie Frappart sees the trip by Malick Fofana (Lyon) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
83' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) takes the corner with a short pass.
83' A quickly taken corner by Angers.
80' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
79' Substitution. Alexandre Lacazette makes his way off the pitch and Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) comes on as his replacement.
78' Thiago Almada will be replaced by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
75' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a snap shot, but his beautiful shot smashed against the right post!
73' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Ousmane Camara is replaced by Emmanuel Biumla (Angers).
72' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Rayan Cherki sprays a pass out to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
72' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nemanja Matic (Lyon) is coming onto the pitch as Tanner Tessmann cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
65' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
62' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Jacques Ekomie and he is replaced by Farid El Melali (Angers).
62' It will be a substitution. Enzo Caumont (Angers) is ready to enter the pitch as Zinedine Ould Khaled walks off.
62' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
61' Thiago Almada (Lyon) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the right post.
60' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
58' What was Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
55' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Melvin Zinga into the bottom right corner.
55' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
55' Melvin Zinga (Angers) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals. PENALTY! One of the players from Lyon is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
53' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
52' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
52' Lyon are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
49' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
48' Corner kick. Thiago Almada (Lyon) is ready to send the ball into the box.
47' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
47' A cross from Jordan Veretout (Lyon) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
43' Thiago Almada (Lyon) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
42' Carlens Arcus (Angers) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Thiago Almada (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
38' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Angers.
35' That's a well-taken pass by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
35' The total number of attempts is 8:3.
33' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) is cleared to safety by the defence.
32' A pass by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
31' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
30' Malick Fofana (Lyon) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
27' A pass from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is intercepted by Melvin Zinga and the move breaks down.
25' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
24' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
23' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
22' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Melvin Zinga, who smothers the ball.
21' What a chance that is! Rayan Cherki swings the ball into the box, and Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
18' What a big chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
18' It looks like Zinedine Ould Khaled (Angers) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

17' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Melvin Zinga shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
14' A free kick into the box, taken by Thiago Almada (Lyon), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
12' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Jordan Lefort (Angers) for his blatant foul.
11' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
11' Malick Fofana (Lyon) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
9' A short pass finds Malick Fofana (Lyon). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
6' Malick Fofana (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Angers have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
2' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
